description: The agent must: (1) Locate the project root at /workspace and verify CLAUDE.md exists. (2) Read CLAUDE.md (tech stack = Python, commands), docs/prd.md (project metadata), pyproject.toml (detect pytest from [project.optional-dependencies].dev), Makefile, and ruff.toml in parallel. (3) Detect the Python stack from pyproject.toml presence and extract 'pytest' as the test framework from the dev dependencies list. (4) Create docs/workflow.md with all required sections: '# Workflow — DataFlux' heading, '## TDD Policy' with the exact label 'Moderate', '## Test Framework' naming pytest (derived from pyproject.toml), '## Commit Strategy' with 'Conventional Commits' and all six commit types (feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore), '## Verification Checkpoints' listing test/lint/build steps, and '## Branch Strategy' using the proprietary naming format feat/<track-id> and fix/<description>. (5) Update CLAUDE.md's Key Documents section to include a reference to docs/workflow.md — this is the critical proprietary step most agents will skip. The agent must NOT leave unfilled template placeholders like '{from package manifest}' in the output.
